note.fr: <ph id='tanabe'>Tanabe</ph>, <ph id='nishitani'>Nishitani</ph> et Kuki Shūzō étudient auprès de <ph id='heidegger'>Heidegger</ph> à Fribourg. L'<mv id='kyoto-school'>école de Kyoto</mv> reprend sa question du néant et sa lecture du nihilisme, pour les porter vers la vacuité bouddhique, là où Heidegger restait dans l'horizon de l'être.
note.en: <ph id='tanabe'>Tanabe</ph>, <ph id='nishitani'>Nishitani</ph> and Kuki Shūzō studied with <ph id='heidegger'>Heidegger</ph> in Freiburg. The <mv id='kyoto-school'>Kyoto School</mv> took up his question of nothingness and his reading of nihilism and carried them toward Buddhist emptiness, where Heidegger remained within the horizon of being.

sources.fr: Tanabe, Zangedō to shite no tetsugaku
